message: interpolate always throws here: name lands in data-text, which Datastar runs as an expression or follows as a signal path, and only a number or a boolean is let in there. Put the value in an attribute of its own, such as data-label, and read it in the expression with el.dataset.label.

interpolate always throws here: css lands in a <style>, where it is read as CSS, and only Trusted(...) is let in there. Choose between classes, or write a number; wrap CSS you wrote yourself in Trusted(...).

interpolate always throws here: src lands in src, which loads code from wherever the value points, and the markup before it does not fix the host. Only Trusted(...) is let in there. Start the value with a path such as /js/ or a whole origin such as https://cdn.example/, so that the value only picks a file there, or wrap a URL you chose yourself in Trusted(...).
Kotlin fills in $title before interpolate sees the markup, so interpolate neither escapes nor refuses it. Mark it with +, and interpolate escapes it.
Kotlin fills in ${title} before interpolate sees the markup, so interpolate neither escapes nor refuses it. Mark it with +, and interpolate escapes it.
Kotlin fills in $$title before interpolate sees the markup, so interpolate neither escapes nor refuses it. Mark it with +, and interpolate escapes it.
